article.headline: Little Rock secures 75-61 victory over Western Illinois
article.description: — Jordan Jefferson scored 25 points as Little Rock beat Western Illinois 75-61 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Little Rock secures 75-61 victory over Western Illinois

categories.description: Western Illinois Leathernecks @ Little Rock Trojans

event.description: Western Illinois Leathernecks @ Little Rock Trojans

keywords: Western Illinois Leathernecks @ Little Rock Trojans
article.story: LITTLE ROCK, Ark. -- — Jordan Jefferson scored 25 points as Little Rock beat Western Illinois 75-61 on Saturday night. Jefferson shot 10 for 16 (3 for 5 from 3-point range) and 2 of 3 from the free-throw line for the Trojans (18-11, 12-6 Ohio Valley Conference). Tuongthach Gatkek scored 15 points and added 12 rebounds and three steals. Mwani Wilkinson shot 5 for 12, including 2 for 5 from beyond the arc to finish with 12 points, while adding eight rebounds. Ryan Myers finished with 17 points and eight rebounds for the Leathernecks (10-19, 4-14). Western Illinois also got 11 points and nine rebounds from Trey Deveaux. Sean Smith also had nine points and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
